object.name: evi.rcfilter~
object.digest: Trapezoidal nonliner onepole rc filter emulation
object.description: A basic analog building block. Efficient, nonlinear analog onepole filter using trapezoidal integration and newton-raphson loop. @see: 'evi_rcfilters.genexpr' for details. A choice of frequency input in Hz (default) or normalised 0..1 (via the <m>prewarp</m> attribute). Optional smoothing is default off. @see: <o>evi.onepole~</o> for a multimode linear version.
object.discussion: Based on some basic C code by Urs Heckman.

inlets.digest: Hz (default) or g depending on 'prewarp' attribute
inlets.description: We have a choice of frequency input in Hz (default) or normalised 0..1, depending on the @prewarp attribute. Optional smoothing (@smooth attribute) is default off.

attributes.name: oversample
attributes.description: 0=1x (default). 1=2x (actually not very good and rarely needed with this filter).

attributes.name: prewarp
attributes.description: If on (defualt), the second inlet expects frequency in Hz and g coefficient warping is performed internally. If off, the second inlet expects a normalised g coefficient 0..1 and this is passed on directly to the filter internally.

attributes.name: smooth
attributes.description: Smoothing time of the internal g coefficient (via the second inlet). If 0, smoothing is CPU-off.
